premium.basis: 61% over the closing price on October 2, 2020, as stated in the Board's rationale

lead_asset_stage: Phase 3 (EXPLORER-HCM study completed), NDA submission planned Q1 2021

value_inflection_events.event: Positive Phase 3 EXPLORER-HCM results for mavacamten announced
Acquisition announcement by Bristol-Myers Squibb at $225.00 per share

leaked_early.details: No pre-deal rumors or public reports of a pending buyout were identified prior to the official announcement.

notes: The deal originated from partnership discussions around danicamtiv in 2019 and evolved into a full acquisition after positive Phase 3 mavacamten data. The process was a limited, bilateral negotiation with only one other party (Party A) contacted, who declined to engage.
